summary: Evotec SE filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of Dr. Joanna Holbrook as Chief Scientific Officer and Management Board member effective November 1, 2026, succeeding a planned leadership transition rather than an abrupt forced exit. A separate voting rights notification (major shareholder stake disclosure under German law, equivalent to a US Schedule 13D/G-type notification) was also furnished. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock are stated. Investors should monitor whether the new CSO signals strategy shifts in discovery platforms or partnerships; no arbitrage angle exists.
